column1: # backlog/standing-reds.tsv - the standing-red register (human directive
# 2026-09-05: "we should not sweep failing tests under the carpet").
# One row per test file that fails on main and is tolerated while its fix is
# in flight. A row MUST name an OPEN ticket (backlog/paused or backlog/active);
# a row naming a closed or absent ticket is an UNOWNED red, which throttles
# intake (BL-1429) and blocks QA approval (Article 4.2). A row is removed in
# the same land that turns the test green. BL-1428 builds the reader and the
# commit guard; until then this file is read by humans and roles.
# Columns, tab-separated: lane<TAB>file<TAB>ticket<TAB>first_seen<TAB>note
#   lane: property | unit | bb | acceptance | shell
#   file: repo-relative path (extension/test/... for the vitest lanes)
#   first_seen: YYYY-MM-DD the red was first recorded anywhere
# Measured 2026-09-05 by the specifier: each property allowlist file run alone
# under vitest.properties.config.mjs; the unit suite run once (16 files / 26
# tests red per vitest; 7 distinct files). Five allowlist rows were green and
# are not registered (BL-1428 removes them from the allowlist).
# Hardening lane: the four gates in backlog/hardening-debt-ledger.yaml from
# 2026-08-19 have all discharged (BL-956's gherkin-mutation 2026-09-05;
# backlog/evidence/BL-1441-BL-620-mutation.md,
